layers.translation_en: Like the tinder that lights fires; always encourage and then good fortune will be the reward for effort.

reading_units.text: 指薪修祜　永绥吉劭

layers.translation_en: Regulate your pace and lead the way; bowing at the Imperial court.

reading_units.text: 矩步引领　俯仰廊庙

word_spans.gloss: to crane one's neck / to await eagerly / to lead / to show the way
lowering and raising of the head / (fig.) small move / pitch (position angle)
imperial court

layers.translation_en: Girt with your belt esteemed and grand; walking with hesitancy as you gaze around your lands.

reading_units.text: 束带矜庄　徘徊瞻眺

word_spans.gloss: to pace back and forth / to dither; to hesitate / (of sales figures etc) to fluctuate

layers.translation_en: Fools and numbskulls; dunderheads and the absurd may deride you.

reading_units.text: 孤陋寡闻　愚蒙等诮

word_spans.gloss: ignorant and inexperienced / ill-informed and narrow-minded
ignorant; stupid

layers.translation_en: At last these will help: that's it, all done, finito, the end.

reading_units.text: 谓语助者　焉哉乎也

word_spans.gloss: (grammatical) predicate
